title: 25th Infantry Division Executes Rapid Infiltration of HIMARS at JPMRC 27-01
description: U.S. Soldiers assigned to the 2-11 Field Artillery Regiment, 25th Division Artillery Brigade, 25th Infantry Division, and U.S. Air Force Airmen with the 15th Wing, execute a High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS) Rapid Infiltration (HIRAIN) live fire as part of the Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center Rotation 27-01, at Marshall Islands, Nov. 13, 2026. A HIRAIN is a vital joint military exercise designed to ensure the rapid deployment of HIMARS rocket systems. This exercise actively employs cargo aircraft to transport HIMARS launchers to remote locations for live-fire missions and swift redeployments. JPMRC 27-01 will integrate U.S. forces, along with military members from the Republic of Korea, Singapore, France, and New Zealand to refine joint capabilities and rehearse tactics, techniques, and procedures required to dominate jungle and archipelagic terrain during large-scale combat operations. The exercise underscores the U.S. Army’s commitment to ensuring regional security and strengthening partnerships in the Indo-Pacific area of responsibility. (U.S. Army video by Spc. Leonardo Martinez Tovar) Interviews: 1st LT. Carlos Rivera, a C-17 Pilot assigned to the 535th Airlift Squadron, 15th Operations Group, 15th Wing, and Pfc. Christopher Donahue, a fire control specialist assigned to the 2-11 Long Range Fires Battalion, 25th Division Artillery Brigade, 25th Infantry Division.
keywords: High-Mobility Artillery Rocket System, HI-RAIN, 2-11 Field Artillery Regiment, JPMRC, HIMARS
